info.name: ApiGateway (JACAG-19)
info.description: Run the folders top to bottom (Collection Runner or one by one) against the whole system started with docker compose (only the Gateway on baseUrl is used). Every run uses unique data and removes the profiles it created. The accounts of the registered users stay in the Authentication Service: nothing deletes an account by its login, on purpose. Before the run set the CURRENT values of adminLogin, adminPassword and internalKey (they are secrets and are not stored in this file). Folder 3 runs as the admin, folder 4 checks what the Gateway refuses, folder 5 proves the undoing of a failed registration, folder 6 places orders as two registered users and as the admin (the Order Service, its owner lookup in the User Service and the ownership rules through the Gateway), folder 7 removes what the run created.

5. Registration rollback (end to end)
38 Register a user (the first time)

request.description: Steps 38-41 prove the undoing of a half-finished registration through the whole system. The admin deletes the profile but not the account (nothing deletes an account by its login), so the next registration with the same email creates a new profile and then fails at the account: the Authentication Service must remove that new profile.

item.name: 39 The admin deletes the profile (the account stays)

exec: pm.test("Detail is the constant text", function () {
pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql("An account with this email already exists");
